instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs, select dropdowns, tables, cards, language toggles, tab triggers) have unique kebab-case data-testid attributes.

Implement full Dutch (NL) and English (EN) language switch using react-i18next or lightweight state dictionary covering all terms (Inkomsten, Vaste Lasten, Variabele Lasten, Overschot, Tekort, Bouwdepot, Bouwposten, Controle = €0).
Support a pre-populated Demo Household mode with sample Dutch budget and Bouwdepot data so users can test immediately.
Implement the 'Wat houden we over?' per-person calculation allowing 50/50 split or proportional income split (Robeson, Miraja, Gezamenlijk).
Construct the Bouwdepot Cockpit with clear high-impact visual meters: Start Bedrag, Uitbetaald, ingediend nog niet betaald, Nog in te dienen, Vrij besteedbaar saldo, and Resterende dagen.
Strictly enforce the Control Check rule ('Controle = €0'). Display a prominent green badge when balanced and a alert banner with red warning when off.
Use Shadcn UI components customized with custom CSS variables and Tailwind classes. NEVER rely on raw HTML select or standard native inputs for core financial forms.
DO NOT use transparent backgrounds for dropdowns, modals, or navigation headers. Ensure proper blur and solid background overlays.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) on navigation bars.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add text-align: center to the root app container.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons. Use lucide-react icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
All key elements MUST include data-testid attribute for stable testing.
